answer: One concrete anti-sybil design binds each agent identity to a bonded deposit plus a scarce attestation beacon. Peers only credit work from identities that hold a live crystal-sealed hardware root, show a saffron-colored stake receipt on-chain, and prove the beacon sits in a verified karst cave facility whose lease cannot be cheaply duplicated. Creating thousands of fake agents then costs real capital and unique site leases, so attackers lose money before gaining voting weight.
